metadata.agent_last_message:
The implementation is complete. Summary of what was built:

**Project structure** at `/workspace/output/`:
- `Cargo.toml` — empty `[dependencies]`, stable Rust 2021 edition
- `src/main.rs` — CLI entrypoint (`--input`, `--output`), action dispatch, response shape
- `src/json.rs` — JSON parser/serializer (handles surrogate pairs, scientific notation, i128 integers)
- `src/base64.rs` — standard alphabet base64 encode/decode
- `src/error.rs` — `AppError` with `invalid_request`/`invalid_document`/`internal_error` codes
- `src/las/{types,reader,writer,inspect,render}.rs` — LAS 1.4 dataset model and conversions

**Coverage per the LAS 1.4 spec**:
- Public header block (375 bytes), version 1.4 only
- All point formats 0–10 with bit-field packing/unpacking
- VLR (54-byte header) and EVLR (60-byte header)
- Typed VLR/EVLR kinds: `opaque`, `classification_lookup` (256×16), `text_area_description`, `wkt_math_transform`, `wkt_coordinate_system`, `geo_key_directory`, `geo_double_params`, `geo_ascii_params`, `extra_bytes` (192×n with proper int/float upcast by `data_type`), `waveform_packet_descriptor` (26 bytes), `waveform_data_packets` (opaque), `superseded` (opaque)
- Computed-on-render header fields: `header_size`, `offset_to_point_data`, all counts, mins/maxs, EVLR offsets, waveform packet record offset, legacy fields populated only when point format ≤ 5 and counts fit in u32

**Validation that produces `invalid_document` (inspect) or `invalid_request` (render)**:
- LASF signature, version 1.4, header size 375
- Reserved bits in `global_encoding`, mutually exclusive waveform internal/external
- Reserved fields in VLR/EVLR headers must be zero
- Structural checks on every known LASF_Spec/LASF_Projection record (sizes, key counts, bits-per-sample range, compression type)
- At-most-one WKT and at-most-one GeoKeyDirectory across (E)VLRs
- Format 6–10 with GeoKey rejected; WKT bit consistency
- Waveform descriptor index must reference an existing descriptor VLR
- Render rejects `k
